name: Logibar
author: mryll
description: Combined battery status for supported Logitech Lightspeed and Unifying devices in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Click: open panel and query devices. Middle click: query devices. Requires logibar-status on PATH.

schema.label: Colors
schema.description: Monochrome rendering uses foreground tones only — severity stays readable through the numbers and glyphs. none: no color anywhere. bar-only: colored bar face, plain panel. panel-only: the reverse.

schema.label: Show keyboard
schema.description: Show responding keyboards and recent last-known battery readings. The panel names each model.

schema.label: Show mouse
schema.description: Show responding mice and recent last-known battery readings. The panel names each model.

schema.label: Show headset
schema.description: Battery of the PRO X 2 LIGHTSPEED headset.

schema.label: Show other devices
schema.description: Show responding devices of other kinds and their recent last-known battery readings.
